product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker helps critical-infrastructure asset owners and operators plan, build, operate, and maintain projects, sites, and assets through a centralized asset lifecycle management platform.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page was found; /pricing returns 404, and the website directs prospects to request a demo.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog index contains industry, product, and marketing content; no qualifying collection of engineer-authored product-internals posts was identified.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation portal was identified; product-object and integration documentation is behind a Salesforce Community login.

model_provider.notes: Its Scout engineering posting explicitly names Anthropic and OpenAI LLM APIs; specific deployed model versions are not stated.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center lists a SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001:2022 certification.

last_funding.notes: The latest funding record is an October 2022 Series D investment with an undisclosed amount. Separately, Sitetracker announced $66 million in Series D equity and a $30 million revolving credit facility in September 2022; those amounts are not assigned to the later undisclosed record.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded investment is from October 2022, before the requested 18-month window.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 23, 2026, Sitetracker and 5×5 Technologies introduced a portfolio-scale data-to-digital-twin workflow for wireless infrastructure owners.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ben Bouchez's dated profile lists a May 2026 start at Sitetracker as Regional Vice President, Sales, South Europe.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page states that Sitetracker is built natively on Salesforce; this is a platform-stack signal, not confirmation of its internal sales CRM.
